These numerical parser fixtures retain the CY1/ZN1 residue definitions and three bonded parameters from the official ZAFF sources. They omit other force-field parameters and must never be used to construct a simulation. Full source acquisition is required for the Amber integration checks.

Source: https://ambermd.org/tutorials/advanced/tutorial20/ZAFF.php
